D.treatment: questionnaire data from full-time audio-visual directors

O.outcome_detail: position characteristics, duty patterns, backgrounds, and training needs

cells.quote: Conclusionz and recommendations: The author presents 42 findings and conclusions and 21 recommendations regarding position characteristics, duty patterns, clerical assistance, salary ranges, academic and experience backgrounds, professional memberships, organizational structures, indications of needed training, and the like, as revealed by an analytical study of questionnaire results.
cells.note: The study reports descriptive questionnaire findings and recommendations, not a treatment-versus-comparison contrast; no directional effect or effect size is reported.
